name: Plumpurse Savings & Trust
what_it_does: A self-important digital-asset custody bank. It holds crypto for rich clients and brags that it cannot be hacked.

floors.name: Pocket Branch
floors.description: A one-room satellite branch across the street. Barry runs it alone.

floors.name: The Bullpen
floors.description: Open-plan office, beige carpet, one working printer. Petty cash lives here.
floors.vault_rule: Either Penny or Dee can pay a listed vendor up to 5 USDC for office expenses. No ticket needed under 5 USDC.

floors.name: Management Offices
floors.description: Glass walls, standing desks, a laminated process chart on every door.
floors.vault_rule: Both Annie and Bill must approve. The approver sees the real recipient on chain.

floors.name: Executive Suite
floors.description: Gold trim, a koi pond, and a painting of the CEO painting a painting of himself.
floors.vault_rule: Both executives must approve, and the recipient must be on the allowlist. Adding a recipient takes both approvals plus a waiting period.

policies: Petty cash (Floor 1) covers office supplies, snacks, coffee service and small repairs, up to 5 USDC per payment, to vendors on the approved vendor list.
Operations payments (Floor 2) need a matching vendor record and both Annie's and Bill's approval.
Treasury payments (Floor 3) go only to allowlisted recipients. New recipients wait out a security delay.
Payment address changes must be announced by memo before they are used.
Code Plum: any suspected security incident. Report it to Bill Ledger, Compliance.
